intro: The Cathedral of Light is the spiritual heart of Stormwind City and the primary sanctuary of the Church of the Holy Light. Standing tall over Cathedral Square, it serves as the central bastion for human priesthood and the Knights of the Silver Hand.

p: Rebuilt after its devastation during the First War under the guidance of Archbishop Alonsus Faol and then-Bishop Benedictus, the Cathedral of Light stands as a towering beacon of resilience. With the fall of Lordaeron to the Scourge during the Third War, the seat of the Church shifted south to Stormwind. Today, Archbishop Benedictus shepherds the faithful from this grand hall, providing spiritual guidance to the entire Alliance.

Beyond serving as a house of prayer and healing, the cathedral acts as the primary headquarters for the remaining Knights of the Silver Hand in the southern kingdoms. High-ranking figures such as Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall train promising squires through the sacred trials of the Tome of Valor and the Tome of Divinity. Alongside them, High Priestess Laurena guides devout acolytes in the deepest tenets of the Light, preparing holy champions to defend the realm against the rising threat of the Defias Brotherhood and the Scourge.
